create temp view q as select l.history_id,l.person_key,l.issue_key,i.project_key,l.seconds from model.logged_time l join model.issue i using(issue_key) where l.seconds>0 and l.logged_at>='2009-07-01+00' and l.logged_at<'2009-10-01+00';
select 1;

with q as (select l.history_id,l.person_key,l.issue_key,i.project_key,l.seconds from model.logged_time l join model.issue i using(issue_key) where l.seconds>0 and l.logged_at>='2009-07-01+00' and l.logged_at<'2009-10-01+00'), e as (select person_key id, sum(seconds) value from q group by 1 having count(distinct project_key)>=2) select * from e where value>=(select value from e order by value desc offset 4 limit 1) order by value desc

with q as (select l.history_id,l.person_key,l.issue_key,i.project_key,l.seconds from model.logged_time l join model.issue i using(issue_key) where l.seconds>0 and l.logged_at>='2009-07-01+00' and l.logged_at<'2009-10-01+00') select * from q where person_key in (select person_key from q group by 1 having count(distinct project_key)>=2 order by sum(seconds) desc limit 5)
